name: Eleni Papadopoulos
bio:
Eleni’s journey into motorsport began in her grandfather's small repair shop in Thessaloniki, where she spent countless hours tinkering with engines and learning the intricacies of metalwork. She quickly developed a knack for fabrication, mastering welding, machining, and composite materials. Her passion led her to pursue a degree in Mechanical Engineering, specializing in automotive design. 

After graduating, Eleni gained valuable experience working for a local racing team, where she honed her skills in building and modifying chassis components. She's known for her meticulous attention to detail and her ability to troubleshoot complex mechanical problems under pressure. Her innovative approach to problem-solving sets her apart, often devising creative solutions to improve performance and reliability. Eleni is driven by a desire to contribute to a team's success and thrives in collaborative environments where she can share her expertise and learn from others.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair often pulled back in a practical braid
physical.description: Eleni is of average height with a lean build, her focused gaze reflecting her dedication to her craft.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with sketches and calculations.
Has a habit of tapping her wrench against surfaces when deep in thought.
Insists on cleaning her workspace thoroughly at the end of each day.
